verdict: Yes, with good packaging. Swadeshi Blessings from Udaipur pitched clay utensils and cookware on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Buyers want to cook in natural clay again, but breakage in shipping and the need to season clay pots must be handled carefully.
angle: Clay pots, bottles and cookware appeal to buyers moving away from non-stick and aluminium. Potters in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Manipur and Bengal make them cheaply. Clear instructions on seasoning and care prevent returns, and sturdy packaging prevents breakage.
